turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Who is the woman in the portrait?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: The one where the lady is sitting.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Oh, that's Carlotta, sir.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: You'll find it in the catalogue:

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: "Portrait of Carlotta."

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: She never heard of Carlotta Valdes.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Nothing.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: And when she goes to those places...

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: She is not my wife.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Why did she never tell her daughter?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Are you all right?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Madeleine...

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Please... thank you... please...

turns.speaker: p5
turns.quote:
Of course Mr. Ferguson is to be 
		congratulated for having once saved 
		the woman's life when, in a previous 
		fit of aberration, she threw herself 
		into the Bay. It is a pity that 
		knowing her suicidal tendencies he 
		did not make a greater effort the 
		second time. But we are not here to 
		pass judgment on Mr. Ferguson's lack 
		of initiative. He did nothing, and 
		the law has little to say on the 
		subject of things left undone.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: We've reached the verdict.

turns.speaker: p5
turns.quote: And what is your verdict.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote:
We find that Madeleine Elster 
		committed suicide while being out of -- 
		while being out of unsound mind.

turns.speaker: p5
turns.quote:
Your verdict will be so recorded.  
		Dismissed.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Let's go, Scottie.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Scottie --

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Scottie, I'm sorry. That was rough.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
He had no right to say that. It was 
		my responsibility. You didn't know 
		her. I shouldn't have got you 
		involved.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
No, there's nothing you have to say 
		to me. I'm getting out, Scottie. For 
		good. I can't stay here. I'm winding 
		up her affairs, and mine. I'm going 
		to get as far away as I can. Probably 
		Europe. And I'll probably never come 
		back.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
Good-bye, Scottie. If there's anything 
		I can do for you before I go...

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
There was no way for them to 
		understand. But you and I know who 
		killed Madeleine.
